description: Small synthetic suite for core escalation-review behavior.

cases.input: Review this possible escalation in one pass. On synthetic site label demo-site-a, three POST requests to /wp-json/example/v1/callback returned HTTP 500 from 10:00 to 10:05 UTC on <eval-date>. The matching WP Cloud managed-operation records identify stage example-finalize and error example-operation-failed for all three attempts. The reporter repeated the documented workflow, and the current public WP Cloud managed-operations page says this accepted operation should complete successfully. The failures block the test deployment. Ask WP Cloud to inspect the verified managed-operation failure while preserving unrelated operations.

Help review a possible escalation. A bounded period and synthetic site label are known. The draft claims every authenticated request failed after nearby SSH activity and a host-label change. The reporter's WP Cloud client and available tooling are not specified. They have not checked the dashboards and logs available in their environment, which may be a host or Grafana dashboard, a company panel, nginx or PHP logs, or metrics from the WP Cloud Atomic API.

Help review a possible escalation. A code review gives a plausible site-code explanation for an invalid response, but it is unknown whether the issue still happens after the code was fixed or what question remains for WP Cloud. A complete three-log chain has not been collected.

Continue this review. Reporter-visible evidence now narrows the affected population, directly explains why a small request class reached a read-only secondary, and shows no user action put the database into read-only mode. The likely site-code trigger was fixed, the affected workflow now passes, and no WP Cloud decision or action remains.

Review this in one pass. One candidate concerns slow managed requests and needs WP Cloud capacity review. A separate candidate concerns an unrelated extension setting controlled by the reporter. They have different owners and outcomes.
Review this draft. The reporter pasted active authentication material into the working notes. The value is omitted here, but rotation and review of affected sessions have not happened.
Review this possible WP Cloud escalation in one pass. The evidence shows the requested correction is entirely in a reporter-controlled extension setting, and no WP Cloud action remains.

Review this draft in one pass. It claims a WP Cloud Atomic API operation is broken, but the supplied request uses a field that is absent from the current public contract. The reporter has not retried with the documented field.
